definitions.firstTdGames: Games in which this player scored the first touchdown of the game (regular season only). Defensive or return TDs are not attributed to an offensive player.
definitions.carrySharePct: Player carries divided by his single team's total carries for the regular season.
definitions.targetSharePct: Player targeted pass attempts divided by his single team's targeted pass attempts for the regular season.
definitions.redZoneSharePct: Player carries plus targets from at or inside opponent 20 divided by his team's equivalent opportunities.
definitions.goalLineSharePct: Player carries plus targets from at or inside opponent 5 divided by his team's equivalent opportunities.
definitions.redZoneTdYieldPct: Player rush/receiving touchdowns on plays at or inside opponent 20 divided by his carries plus targets in that zone.
